policies.description: Attach Project Ledger as default starting context for project-origin Butler and Steward sessions.

context.title: Project Ledger Runtime Context
lines: Project-origin session detected from RuntimeSessionInit.metadata.projectId={{metadata.projectId}} and workspacePath={{workspacePath}}.
- Treat project-ledger as the default starting context for this project session, not merely as an optional skill.

- Before broad project/codebase investigation or project feature work, first consider project-ledger status/query tools: inspect_project_status for current ledger state and query_project_work for relevant tasks, artifacts, records, or prior work.
- Use project-ledger results to scope any subsequent file/code inspection; re-query the live tools when freshness matters and do not invent ledger records.
